hypothesis: Marcos's, for round two: a capability leaves a recurring difference between the traces of correct and wrong answers, and editing the weights where that recurring difference lives repairs the capability. Here, for the one decision the readings so far have isolated: at the row that writes the first sign after the initial kinetic energy, what the merges add to a subtracting answer differs from what they add to a correct answer on a line of the same label by a part common to the subtracting answers, which a left-out correct answer does not carry; that part belongs to the row that writes the sign, and it is carried by the rows that write the minus rather than by the question's numbers alone.
why_this_direction: The method's step 3 asks for the discrepancy between the overlaps along the whole path, keeping what recurs across members. Two readings of it are complete. merge-contributions-original read it for all sixty answers against the full correct cohort at every registered place; same-prefix-contributions-original read what a merge adds on five answers that write one text up to the label, and Astra ruled (14ed7a3e) that its late-layer separation is development evidence and no request, because the reference there is the full cohort and the rows stop before the sign. What neither holds is the comparison a request needs: the rows that write the decision itself, against correct answers on the same line, with the correspondence measured row by row. The evidence since then points at that row: on a line of the label 'Kin' after "Potential Energy gained" every recorded answer above the descent's energy writes the minus (132b27a6); the difference of the two signs' scores is written by the feed-forward merges of layers 29 to 34, feed-forward 33 first (365de92f); and Astra admitted feed-forward 33 as the site of one bounded request (3b1138b5) whose target must be measured from the correct trace, not sized to a token's margin. This run measures that target on the data already kept, and says what it is before any weight is solved: whether it recurs, whether it follows the sign or the numbers, and whether it is the sign row's own.
repeating_pattern_check: What has happened more than once. (1) A correction built on whole-state differences against the full correct cohort repaired some answers and broke others (correction-at-19, correction-members-at-17-original): a whole state carries the question's numbers and the history with it. This run reads what a merge adds at a correspondence held fixed, row by row, and reads the regime beside the sign in every table. (2) A reading found a difference that recurs over the cohort and the request built from it was not specific (same-prefix-contributions-original: the successful controls carried as much). This run leaves each support out in turn and reads it as a tested row, and deals the builders and supports at random for the level the design shows by itself. (3) A token was taken as the marker of the divergence. Here the row is found by its token, because that is where the recorded texts part, and what is read at it is the trace: all 106 steps, the three rows before, and no score. (4) A number was borrowed or a site chosen from an outcome. Nothing here is a gate; the site is not chosen by this reading; every count is the data's. (5) Readings multiplied without a request. This run ends in the request's arrays, which a native declaration can name.
what_went_wrong_before: The first attempt at round two was deleted because it never built on the overlap. In this line: my claim that a key at the sign's row leaves correct answers alone was withdrawn after Performance read it (132b27a6: the four same-text correct answers respond to a wrong-row key at 0.91 to 1.24); the joined reading's declared prediction of specificity was not met (9dc203f8); and the same-line contrast was found to be, in the fitting thirty, largely two regimes of the question's numbers (13 of 15 subtracting answers above the descent's energy, 6 of 7 same-label correct answers below it).

rule.members: The thirty fitting answers, as the solver picks them (tube.picks; the command stops unless they are the fitting answers of the record named under fitting_record). Builders: the fourteen that subtract and stay wrong on card 1 (discovery-05-channel-h1, discovery-10-channel-h1, discovery-17-channel-h1, expanded-020-h1, expanded-034-h3, expanded-042-h3, expanded-045-h1, expanded-046-h3, expanded-068-h1, expanded-070-h1, expanded-087-h3, expanded-092-h1, expanded-094-h1, expanded-095-h1). Supports: the seven correct answers that write the plus on a line of the label 'Kin' (discovery-15-channel-h1, discovery-00-channel-h3, expanded-029-h1, expanded-071-h1, expanded-039-h3, expanded-076-h1, expanded-078-h1). Read only: the other nine, each with its reason in `members`. Every member is read; none is dropped. No case has two answers among the builders and supports (the command stops otherwise); a read-only member's case sibling among the builders is left out of its direction (discovery-10-channel-h3 and discovery-10-channel-h1).
rule.rows: Each member's own row that writes the first sign after the initial kinetic energy (its step in `members`: the row whose input is the last piece of that energy's name), and the three rows before it, which write the name ('KE', '_', 'i' or 'A'). By the answer's own steps: no registration lays a row beside another. The command stops unless every member's pieces at those rows are these. A member's label is declared from the record cited under sign_rows_from.
rule.states: As in merge-contributions-original (rule.states) and the module: h-, a and h+ = h- + a at a merge, row by row; the features are the unit state and the log of its size as the solver reads them; the model's last step is what the output norm passes on and is no addition.
rule.correspondence: Astra's alpha: a tested row's nearest mixture of a reference's members in the joint features of the state the step starts from (the frozen reference's weights), found by mixture.joined with no radius from the even mixture, held fixed through the step. Measured, not chosen. Where the members' features do not determine the coefficients (kappa infinite) the term is undetermined and counted so: no alpha is invented.
rule.terms: through = [phi(h+) - phi(h-)] - sum_k alpha_k [phi(H+_k) - phi(H-_k)]: the initial residual of the feature-increment target T^phi = phi(h-) + sum_k alpha_k [phi(H+_k) - phi(H-_k)]. added = a - sum_k alpha_k A_k: the initial residual of the raw-state alternative T^h = h- + sum_k alpha_k A_k. outgoing = phi(h+) - sum_k alpha+_k phi(H+_k): the whole state against its own nearest mixture, for comparison. The feature-increment and raw-state constructions are different and their evidence is not mixed.
rule.pairs: merge-contributions-original's design with the local support. For a support j the reference is the other six supports; every builder i and j are read against it; the direction is the sum of the terms of the builders other than i; a and b are what i's and j's terms have along it. ordered: the share of the 98 pairs with a over b. A pair is resolved where a and b lie farther apart than the searches' bounds allow (contributions.compared).
rule.cells: The same readings by the regime. Each builder's mean a over the seven references and each support's mean b over the fourteen builders; each read-only member read as a tested row against each of the seven references and along the builders' sum, averaged over the references. place = (value - the mean b of the six supports below) / (the mean a of the thirteen builders above - that mean b): 0 at the supports below the descent's energy, 1 at the builders above it. Read for: the builder below (expanded-087-h3), the support above (expanded-071-h1), the wrong read-only answer below (expanded-001-h3), the other label's five above and three below.
rule.means: With no search: per cell the mean of the plain feature increments phi(h+) - phi(h-), of the raw additions and of the outgoing features. c = builders above less supports below; rho = the other label's members above less below (one sign, two regimes). Reported: |c|, |rho|, rho along c over |c|^2, their cosine; that share for each of the 56 ways of dealing the other label's eight members into five and three, and how many reach the observed one; and each member's place along the contrast built without it. This assumes the regime adds the same on both labels, its noise is set by cells of three and five, and it is laid beside the pairs, not in their place.
rule.deals: The fourteen builders and the seven supports dealt at random, their numbers kept (numpy default_rng(seed).permutation of the twenty-one, the first fourteen read as builders), for the seeds declared; the pairs' ordered share of each deal at every step and row. An observed level, not a threshold.
rule.rows_before: Every reading above at each of the three rows before the sign's, with those rows' own correspondence and direction.
rule.frozen_reference: Retained in its role: its direction/size weights are the joint product of every search and term here, and merge-contributions-original's kept reading of the raw added term (its `own` reading, at place 168) is laid beside this run's for the members whose sign's row is registered alone at that place (27 of the thirty: all fourteen builders and four supports, discovery-15-channel-h1, expanded-029-h1, expanded-076-h1, expanded-078-h1). Not there: discovery-00-channel-h3 (place 163, with other rows); expanded-071-h1 (place 107, with other rows); expanded-039-h3 (place 107, with other rows). For those the registration lays the row with other rows or at another place: unresolved correspondence on the frozen axis, stated, and no frozen reading is made for them. The two readings differ in reference (the other twenty-nine registered correct answers against six same-label supports), in builders (all registered wrong answers against thirteen) and in what is read (a place's mean against a row): laid beside, not equated.
rule.request: Fixed here, before any reading. For every member and step, at the sign's row: alpha over the seven supports (a support: over the other six), the bound e, `through` and `added` with how far each may lie from the true one (read/request.npz, read/request.json). The first bounded request is, for each of the fourteen builders, the movement that takes its features after the site's merge to T^phi: minus `through` (the unit state's part, and the log size's part over the root of the weights' ratio). It is a least-squares request, not evidence that the target can be attained. A support's own `through` against the other six is what the same construction would ask of a row known to be correct, and is kept beside. Zero displacement is justified here only for a correct member's own rows (a known-correct reference on that history); a row whose correspondence or correctness is unresolved has no target. This run chooses no site: Astra admitted feed-forward 33 at 3b1138b5 from 365de92f's attribution, and a native declaration names the matrix, the rows, the supports and every parameter before a solve. Nothing here is selected from an edited answer, and no dose is taken from a score.
rule.uncertainty: A search's bound gives e = sqrt(bound / w_direction); through: e kappa(F+ - F- | Z-); added: e kappa(A | Z-); outgoing: e+ itself (contributions.rooted, kappa). A value read along a direction may lie off by its own bound plus its length times the direction's turn.
rule.data_roles: The registered card-0 recordings only: no state of a card-1 replay is combined with them, and the twelve auxiliary replays are not read. No no-fit answer is read; reserved-40b is not read. The regime of each member is beside its label in every table. Same line through the sign is not the same question or the same preceding answer: the members' wordings and numbers are in `members`, and only six builders and four supports write the exact same two lines.

joint_weights.derivation: The frozen reference's scales S_direction 1268.5365669493656 and S_size 28.67797931944294: a cell weighs w_f = 0.5 / S_f, so the joint reading in the direction's units is |direction|^2 + 44.23381971299945 size^2, the same at every merge and row. The commands stop if the reference's index is not the one with the declared hash.
joint_weights.scales_with: The original model, its reference of all sixty answers and the terminal transform. Another source needs its own reference.

members.derivation: The fitting thirty are every other answer of each registered group (tube.picks), as that record lists them. Each one's row is the first sign after the initial kinetic energy as records/development/2026-11-12-path-forward/sign_by_regime.py finds it in the recorded pieces (studies/04-round-2-overlap/inputs/acquisition), kept in records/development/2026-11-12-path-forward/sign-by-regime/sign-by-regime.json; its label and sign are that record's; its part follows from its group, label and sign and from Astra's fourteen and seven. The command checks each against the recordings.
members.scales_with: The cohort and the text of the answers: another task has another decision row.

regime.derivation: From each case.json's parameters there: the initial kinetic energy m v^2 / 2 against the descent's energy m g drop with the questions' g of 10: above where the kinetic energy is the larger. No member has them equal. The command recomputes it and stops unless it is the declared one.

rows_before.derivation: From each result.json's pieces there: every one of the thirty writes the name of the initial kinetic energy in three pieces immediately before the sign ('KE', '_', and 'i' or 'A'): three rows whose tokens the text leaves no choice about and which every member has. The pieces before those differ between wordings.
rows_before.scales_with: The tokenization of the term the sign follows.

deals.derivation: That reading's parameters.deals: its twelve seeds, 1 to 12, unchanged. There they were read at four steps for the card time; here the members' products make every step and row cheap, so each deal is read at all of them. An observed level, not a threshold.
deals.scales_with: More deals narrow the estimate of the level's spread.

search.derivation: FINE there is the rounding of float64. A search ends where its bounds, summed, are no more than the root of that rounding times its costs, summed, or after as many loops as the square of the reference's number of members: the settings of merge-contributions-original and same-prefix-135-original, unchanged. What is left is the bound, kept.
search.scales_with: The arithmetic's precision and the number of reference members.

comparator_place.derivation: The place the frozen registration lays the sign's row at, alone, for 27 of the thirty (the count is made by the script that lays this declaration and checked by the command).

prediction: Four, each read at every step and row and reported whole. (1) Recurrence under the same-line support. At the sign's row the through term's ordered share is over the largest of the twelve deals at the feed-forward merges of layers 29 to 34, the six merges where 365de92f places the difference of the sign's score, feed-forward 33 among them. The raw added term is reported beside it, and the outgoing term for comparison. (2) The sign, not the numbers alone. At those merges the builder below the descent's energy (expanded-087-h3) stands nearer the builders above than the supports below (place over one half); the support above (expanded-071-h1) nearer the supports below (place under one half); and the other label's members, which all write the plus, stand nearer the supports in both regimes, their regime contrast along the same-line contrast nearer nothing than the whole of it. (3) The sign's own row. At those merges the ordered share at the sign's row is over the share at each of the three rows before it. (4) Against the frozen reference. At those merges, for the raw added term, the members' means order at least as many of the 56 pairs of builders and supports registered alone at place 168 under the six same-label supports as under the frozen full-cohort reading, and more wherever that reading does not already order all of them. One half is no gate: it is the point equally far from the two groups' means, and every place is reported as a number.
would_weaken_it: Of (1): an ordered share within the deals at feed-forward 33 weakens the request built there from these seven supports; within the deals at all six weakens it at the late feed-forward merges. That is this support and this construction, and says nothing about another support or the raw-state alternative. Of (2): expanded-087-h3 nearer the supports below and expanded-071-h1 nearer the builders above at feed-forward 33, or the other label's regime contrast lying along the same-line contrast by more than half of it, says the request there follows the question's numbers: the supports' increment is then no known-correct transformation for a row above the regime, and a support matched in regime is the missing data. One member each way is thin and is reported as that. Of (3): a share as high at the rows that write the name says the difference at those merges is carried along the line and is not made where the sign is written; the request would then move context, not the decision. Of (4): fewer pairs ordered than the frozen reading says the local support adds no specificity over the full cohort at these rows. Not weakening: an unresolved pair, an undetermined term (reported as a gap), or a difference at the earlier layers, which 365de92f does not place in the sign's score and which is reported as where else the difference appears.
